alkylation reagent: 100 µl alkylation process solution [100 mM NH4HCO3 containing 1% (w/v) iodoacetamide as the alkylation reagent]
alkylation concentration: 100 µl alkylation process solution [100 mM NH4HCO3 containing 1% (w/v) iodoacetamide as the alkylation reagent]
cleavage agent: After adding 100 µl modified trypsin and 50 mM NH4HCO3 (in this order), the mixture was incubated overnight at 30 °C.
instrument: Eluted peptides were analyzed using Q-Exactive Plus MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
labeling: Statistical analysis of protein spectral counts was performed using Scaffold (version 4.10.0, Proteome Software Inc., OR, USA).
reduction reagent: 100 µl reduction processing solution [100 mM NH4HCO3 containing 0.15% (w/v) dithiothreitol as the reducing agent]
reduction concentration: 100 µl reduction processing solution [100 mM NH4HCO3 containing 0.15% (w/v) dithiothreitol as the reducing agent]
